sceneDescription: Lesikhungo simelela le-node ye-Helia yesiphequluli. Ema-node laluhlata lokhanyako njengamanje axhunywe kusiphequluli futsi anemugca loya enkabeni. Ema-node la-Violet atfolakala ngekusebentisa umzila we-browser kepha akaxhunyiwe. Ema-node egolide kukhona kuxhumana lokuvulekile lokubikwa yi-daemon yendzawo leyehlukile ye-Kubo; akusiko kuxhumana kwesiphequluli futsi kute umugca loya kulesikhungo. Tinkhanyeti letifile te Slate tigcina umlandvo longahlanganiswa, futsi umugca wabo webufakazi ususwa kuphela ngemuva kwekuncishiswa. Libanga kusuka kumabalave lasemkhatsini lalinganiswa latency; bontsanga lengakalinganiswa bahlale umjikeleto wangaphandle, kanye nemacembu e-angle lekuhamba lokubonwako. Tinkhanyeti letihlobisako letingemuva atimeleli bontsanga. Le orbit yangaphandle lebutsakatsaka iphawula insimu ye Kubo lengeniswako futsi akusiyo uxhumano. Umphetfo wekudlulisela uvela kuphela uma i-ID yekudlulisela ikhona kusethi yebontsanga lebonwako; topology yekungacabangi yebontsanga ayikaze inferred. Sebentisa umhloli bontsanga lwati lolufanako ngendlela yembhalo.
fallbackBody: Ledivayisi ayikwatanga kwenta umongo we-WebGL lophephile. Kubukwa kwe Helia bukhoma kuhlala kutfolakala ngekusebentisa umhloli webontsanga.
